contradicting_evidence: ETH's completed-hour rebound and ETH/BTC improvement could develop into broader participation if sustained.
The small-alt Top-100-tail proxy is less negative than the large/mid buckets, with approximately 51% outperforming BTC, allowing selective strength despite weak aggregate breadth.
Stablecoin supply growth and neutral sentiment do not support treating the current weakness as an established broad contraction.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Uneven participation is more defensible than a one-way market call: BTC may remain the relative anchor, ETH's rebound may be tested, and large/mid alts may struggle to sustain advances. A broader retest is plausible, but weak participation and one negative flow session are insufficient to forecast a synchronized decline.
falsification_conditions: BTC and ETH sustain a coordinated advance while ETH/BTC strengthens and large/mid-alt breadth improves across successive observations; this would replace the mixed outlook with a more coherent upside case.

BTC loses its relative resilience while ETH and the observed alt buckets weaken together, accompanied by persistent selling and repeated adverse flows; this would replace dispersion with a broader downside case.
